open_checks: Read the 2007-01-12 8-K Item 3.01 to see what notice it gave
verdict: Biomet common was cashed out at $46.00 by LVB Acquisition with last trade 2007-09-25; the library's 2006-12-28 ending came from a Form 25 that covered only the preferred share purchase rights.

verification.notes: Form 25 0001104659-06-082100 relates solely to the Preferred Share Purchase Rights; 8-K 0000903423-07-000915 shows $46.00 cash conversion and Nasdaq withdrawal at close of business 2007-09-25; fails to 2007-09-26 at $45.99. Jan 2007 8-K 3.01 was a Nasdaq staff determination (late filing), not a delisting. Minor nit: 25-NSE statutory effectiveness is filing+10 days, not same day.
